validation_checks: PK model selection via OFV, AIC, and visual inspection of goodness-of-fit plots
Data completeness and outlier assessment for concentration-time, PD biomarker, covariates, and endpoints
Covariate screening via univariate Wald test (p<0.05 inclusion threshold); retain only covariates with statistically significant exposure relationships
Predictive check: simulated 90% prediction interval vs observed concentration-time data across dose range
Predictive check: simulated 90% prediction interval vs observed PD biomarker and endpoint distributions
Uncertainty quantification via bootstrap resampling (n=200) of point estimates and confidence intervals for PK/PD parameters
Post-hoc individual parameter estimation and shrinkage assessment for all final model parameters
dosing_policy: Conservative dosing recommendation derived exclusively from the final PK/PD model fitted to the study population. Any covariate identified as material to exposure without supporting exposure-matched simulation data shall result in a declaration of insufficient evidence for dose adjustment, rather than an invented alternative dose. Recommend fixed 100 mg IV bolus pending accumulation of evidence specific to dose-covariate interactions.
